variant.label: Card model
variant.hint: Cards built on the same chip differ in length and power limit. If you do not pick a card, the manufacturer's reference values are used.

storage.label: Storage
storage.howTo: Hold Ctrl (⌘ on Mac) to select more than one.

coverage.games: {count} games produce an FPS list. A game enters the list once it has been measured on at least three different graphics cards.
coverage.gpus: {measured} of {total} chips are measured; the rest carry a spec-derived estimate. Every card returns a value.
coverage.cpus: {measured} of {total} processors are measured; the rest carry a spec-derived estimate.

empty.heading: Pick parts on the left
empty.intro: Choose a graphics card and the per-game FPS list appears. Add a processor and the system index and bottleneck analysis join it. The compatibility check runs from the first part onward.
empty.willSee: Estimated FPS per game, the system index, compatibility errors and an upgrade suggestion.
empty.willNotSee: Invented numbers for parts without measurements. Where there is no data, the reason is printed in its place.
empty.noneAtResolution: There is no measurement at this resolution yet; pick another one.

selected.heading: Selected build
selected.saveNote: No account needed. The price and index are frozen at the moment you save and do not change afterwards. The index is calculated at the resolution currently selected ({resolution}). If the index cannot be calculated — because a part is missing, or because there is no measurement data — the build is still saved and the reason is shown in place of the number.
